capabilities: Show a floating monthly calendar from the left ribbon
Open or create a daily note by clicking a date
Create weekly and monthly notes from week and month buttons
Read folder and naming format from the core Daily Notes plugin
Adjust colors and layout with a live preview
disambiguation: Not a general event calendar; it only opens and creates daily, weekly and monthly notes.
extras: Manual installation only; the README notes that fixed text in Moment.js format strings must be wrapped in square brackets, e.g. [Weekly-]gggg-[W]ww. Interface available in Chinese and English.
intentEvidence: It keeps Obsidian's original "Open today's daily note" ribbon action and adds a separate monthly calendar entry
problem: Obsidian's daily notes are reached one at a time through a command or ribbon button, with no calendar view showing which dates already have notes.

relations.evidence: Automatically reads the folder and format from Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin.

summary: Floating monthly calendar that opens or creates daily, weekly and monthly notes using the core Daily Notes folder and format settings.
